name: James Pond Collection
summary:
The James Pond Collection cartridge for Evercade brings together four classic 16-bit games starring the underwater secret agent:

- James Pond: Underwater Agent — Agent Double Bubble Seven dives beneath the waves to take on the dastardly Dr. Maybe in this environmentally-themed action game.
- James Pond 2: Codename RoboCod — Armed with a new Robosuit, James Pond leaps into action to rescue Santa's toy factories from Dr. Maybe in this colourful platformer.
- James Pond 3: Operation StarFI5H — James Pond blasts off on a lunar adventure to thwart Dr. Maybe's plan to mine the Moon's cheese.
- The Aquatic Games Starring James Pond and the Aquabats — James Pond and the Aquabats compete across 10 crazy events in this cartoony multi-sports title.
